# Deferred image pair

Synthetic, hostname-neutral replay: a scripted page whose two thumbnails sit
in one row. Both are 96x72 JPEGs shown in 48x36 boxes, so each decodes
through the resumable raster decode at its box size. A paragraph carries a
colour filter, as elements on Internet Archive search do; that does not keep
the thumbnails off the fixed-image paint publication. Both responses take 20 pumps. Image records use v10
security-header completeness, as http-interactive-images does.

/slow-page pairs left.jpg with slow.jpg, the same pixels as right.jpg behind
a 200-pump response: the first image must not wait for it.
